transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm sorry to take up your time today. I just can’t shake this feeling that I’m a burden to everyone around me and that I’ve let my whole community down. I feel like I don't even deserve to be around people anymore.
Have you ever experienced periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never really had times like that where I felt hyper or full of energy. It's mostly just been the opposite for me, where I feel incredibly heavy, tired, and down.
Have you ever experienced periods like this in the past where you felt this down and hopeless, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
No, I haven't really felt this way before this current stretch of time. Before all of this started about a year and a half ago, I was always pretty active and involved in my community.
During this past year and a half, have you lost interest or pleasure in the activities you used to enjoy?

Yes, it feels like the light has just gone out inside of me. I used to be so involved in my church, the choir, and my gardening club, but now I skip all of it and just stare at my phone when friends or my daughter invite me out. I just can't bring myself to care enough to even text back.
How has your sleep been since you started feeling this way—are you having trouble sleeping, or perhaps sleeping much more than usual?
I haven't really noticed a major change in my sleep, or at least I'm not sure. I just feel so tired and heavy all the time, no matter how much rest I get.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since you started feeling this way, such as eating much less or much more than usual?

I've completely lost my appetite and have to force myself to eat. I'll go all day on just coffee and a cracker, and even though I've noticed my pants are getting loose, I just don't have the interest or energy to fix a real meal.
During this past year and a half, have you had any periods lasting two months or longer where your mood returned to normal and you felt like your usual self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that where I felt like my normal self. This heavy, hopeless feeling and the sense that I'm just a burden have been hanging over me almost the entire time since this all started.
With everything feeling so heavy and hopeless, have you had any thoughts of ending your life, or felt that it would be better if you weren't here anymore?

Yes, I've had thoughts that it would just be easier for everyone if I didn't wake up. On my worst days at work, I picture stepping off the curb in front of one of the trucks, and I have to physically grip the stop sign pole to keep myself from getting too close to the street.
Have you recently been diagnosed with any medical conditions, such as thyroid problems, or started any new medications around the time these feelings began?
No, I haven't been diagnosed with any other medical conditions, like thyroid problems or anything. I also haven't started any new medications around the time these feelings began.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a 1.5-year history of persistent depressed mood, severe anhedonia, significant appetite and weight loss, chronic fatigue, profound feelings of worthlessness and guilt, and active suicidal ideation. She has no history of manic or hypomanic episodes, and her symptoms are not due to a medical condition or substance. This clinical picture meets the criteria for a major depressive episode (F32). Dysthymia (F34.1) was considered due to the chronic 1.5-year duration, but the severity of symptoms and presence of active suicidal ideation point to a major depressive episode.
